description: Source code implementing Redis set commands, including set creation, addition, removal, membership testing, set operations (union, intersection, difference), and iteration.

methods.name: setTypeCreate
methods.description: Creates a set object, choosing between integer set or hash table based on value.

methods.name: setTypeAdd
methods.description: Adds a value to the set, handling different encodings.

methods.name: setTypeRemove
methods.description: Removes a value from the set, handling different encodings.

methods.name: setTypeIsMember
methods.description: Checks if a value is a member of the set.

methods.name: setTypeInitIterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for set traversal.

methods.name: setTypeReleaseIterator
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a set iterator.

methods.name: setTypeNext
methods.description: Advances iterator and returns current element's encoding.

methods.name: setTypeNextObject
methods.description: Returns the next set element as SDS string.

methods.name: setTypeRandomElement
methods.description: Returns a random element from the set.

methods.name: setTypeSize
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the set.

methods.name: setTypeConvert
methods.description: Converts set encoding between intset and hash table.

methods.name: setTypeDup
methods.description: Duplicates a set object.

methods.name: saddCommand
methods.description: Implements the SADD command to add elements to a set.

methods.name: sremCommand
methods.description: Implements the SREM command to remove elements from a set.

methods.name: smoveCommand
methods.description: Implements the SMOVE command to move an element between sets.

methods.name: sismemberCommand
methods.description: Checks if an element is a member of a set.

methods.name: smismemberCommand
methods.description: Checks membership for multiple elements.

methods.name: scardCommand
methods.description: Returns the cardinality of a set.

methods.name: spopWithCountCommand
methods.description: Implements SPOP with count, removing multiple elements.

methods.name: spopCommand
methods.description: Implements the SPOP command to pop a random element.

methods.name: srandmemberWithCountCommand
methods.description: Implements SRANDMEMBER with count, returning multiple random elements.

methods.name: srandmemberCommand
methods.description: Implements SRANDMEMBER command.

methods.name: sinterGenericCommand
methods.description: Generic implementation for set intersection commands.

methods.name: sinterCommand
methods.description: Implements SINTER command.

methods.name: sinterCardCommand
methods.description: Implements SINTERCARD command.

methods.name: sinterstoreCommand
methods.description: Implements SINTERSTORE command.

methods.name: sunionDiffGenericCommand
methods.description: Generic implementation for union/difference commands.

methods.name: sunionCommand
methods.description: Implements SUNION command.

methods.name: sunionstoreCommand
methods.description: Implements SUNIONSTORE command.

methods.name: sdiffCommand
methods.description: Implements SDIFF command.

methods.name: sdiffstoreCommand
methods.description: Implements SDIFFSTORE command.

methods.name: sscanCommand
methods.description: Implements SSCAN command for set iteration.
